name: earth-to-moon-translations
work: Jules Verne, From the Earth to the Moon (De la Terre à la Lune, 1865)
description: Two competing 19th-century English TRANSLATIONS of the same opening chapter ('The Gun Club'), from two different public-domain English editions of the novel. base = the Mercier & King translation. Chapter-1 excerpts; a good mid-difficulty substantive-variation case (the translations diverge in wording but share the narrative).
_siglumNote: The siglum 'towle' is a LEGACY LABEL, not the translator. Attribution corrected 2026-07-24 (Evans/Sherwood bibliographies): PG83 is the Lewis (Louis) Page Mercier & Eleanor E. King translation, NOT George M. Towle (Towle translated 'Around the World in Eighty Days', not this novel). The siglum is kept to avoid renaming files/build-script references; treat it as an opaque id. See ../BIBLIOGRAPHY.md §2.2.

towle.translation: Lewis (Louis) Page Mercier & Eleanor E. King, 'From the Earth to the Moon; and, Round the Moon' — the Sampson Low 'standard' English translation (Oct. 1873). [siglum 'towle' is a legacy misattribution; corrected 2026-07-24]
towle.excerpt: Chapter I 'The Gun Club' (between '^CHAPTER I\.' and '^CHAPTER II\.')

moonvoyage.translation: 'The Moon-Voyage' (Ward, Lock & Co. edition, illustrated by Henry Austin) — a DIFFERENT English translation of the same two novels; likely the T. H. Linklater translation (George Routledge & Sons, 1877, 'From the Earth to the Moon Direct and Round the Moon'), reissued under this title. Translator attribution PROBABLE, not confirmed.
moonvoyage.excerpt: Chapter 'The Gun Club' (between '^THE GUN CLUB\.' and '^PRESIDENT BARBICANE')

full.description: Whole-novel witnesses under full/ for scale collation testing. BOTH source eBooks bundle two novels ('From the Earth to the Moon' then its sequel 'Round the Moon'); the full witnesses take ONLY the first novel (from the Gun-Club opening up to '^ROUND THE MOON') so the pair is like-for-like.

witnesses.full/towle.txt: ~40.7k words, from PG83 (Mercier & King tr., 1873; siglum 'towle' is legacy), Ch.I to just before 'ROUND THE MOON'
witnesses.full/moonvoyage.txt: ~51.5k words, from PG12901 ('The Moon-Voyage', Ward Lock / likely Linklater tr., 1877), 'THE GUN CLUB.' to just before 'ROUND THE MOON.'

full.collationResult: ~7,362 variants (5,684 substitutions, 741 deletions, 825 insertions, 112 moved); ~2.2 s (release). Alignment: 5,796 shared points, 9.4% max off-diagonal drift, 98.3% monotonic — a smooth diagonal (the honest divergence of two different translations).

notes: Excerpt pair yields ~329 variants (246 substitutions, 36 deletions, 31 insertions, 16 transpositions) — the same Gun-Club/Baltimore opening rendered by two translators ('War of the Rebellion' vs 'Federal war', etc.). Both excerpt witnesses collate cleanly. The full/ witnesses (whole first novel) are for scale testing — see the 'full' block.
